question: What will be the average daily mean temperature in Toronto over the 7 days ending October 13, 2026, in degrees Celsius?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the mean of the daily mean 2-metre air temperatures from 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-13 at latitude 43.65, longitude -79.38 (Toronto), from the ERA5 reanalysis as served by the Open-Meteo historical weather API (archive-api.open-meteo.com), in degrees Celsius.
research:
## 1. Resolution source
- The question settles on the Open-Meteo ERA5 archive (daily `temperature_2m_mean`), averaged over 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-13. Open-Meteo snaps the request to the nearest grid cell, 43.69N, 79.41W. [Open-Meteo archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=43.65&longitude=-79.38&start_date=2026-08-25&end_date=2026-09-14&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=America/Toronto)
- 2026-09-14: latest value I pulled was 16.7 C. Recent daily means: 09-11 17.6, 09-12 20.8, 09-13 22.4. The 2026-09-01 to 09-14 average is about 20.4 C. [Open-Meteo archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=43.65&longitude=-79.38&start_date=2026-08-25&end_date=2026-09-14&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=America/Toronto)
- Note: I requested data in the America/Toronto timezone. If the question uses GMT day boundaries, values could shift slightly.

## 2. Current status
- The window starts in about three weeks, so no data for it exists yet and nothing settles the question. Early-to-mid September 2026 was warm, with daily means mostly 17 to 22 C. Weather that far ahead is mostly unpredictable.

## 3. Recent news
- 2026-09 (exact date unclear): The Weather Network's Ontario fall outlook leans warmer than normal for the season overall. It says temperatures may run "surprisingly close to seasonal" from mid-September through mid-October, and the stronger warm signal comes in late fall. It also expects fewer fall storms and drier-than-normal conditions, and points to El Niño as a key driver. [TWN](https://www.theweathernetwork.com/en/news/weather/seasonal/ontario-2026-fall-forecast)
- 2026 (summer release): The Old Farmer's Almanac calls for a cool, wet Ontario autumn, with October rebounding to about 11 C (near normal). One write-up mentions a chilly start to October. The Almanac has little proven skill. [Narcity](https://www.narcity.com/fall-forecast-ontario-2026-chilly-temperatures-snow-showers), [Curiocity](https://curiocity.com/fall-forecast-ontario-2026/)
- Toronto's normal October daily average is about 11.2 C (station normal, not ERA5). [Streets of Toronto](https://streetsoftoronto.com/?p=217934)

## 4. Base rates
Same window (Oct 7-13), same Open-Meteo ERA5 series:
- 2016-10: 14.2 C
- 2017-10: 16.4 C
- 2018-10: 15.2 C
- 2019-10: 12.9 C
- 2020-10: 13.1 C
- 2021-10: 18.3 C (every day 17.2 to 19.3) [archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=43.65&longitude=-79.38&start_date=2021-10-01&end_date=2021-10-20&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=America/Toronto)
- 2022-10: 11.4 C [archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=43.65&longitude=-79.38&start_date=2022-10-07&end_date=2022-10-13&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=America/Toronto)
- 2023-10: 10.3 C [archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=43.65&longitude=-79.38&start_date=2023-10-07&end_date=2023-10-13&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=America/Toronto)
- 2024-10: 11.1 C [archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=43.65&longitude=-79.38&start_date=2024-10-07&end_date=2024-10-13&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=America/Toronto)
- 2025-10: 13.4 C [archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=43.65&longitude=-79.38&start_date=2025-10-07&end_date=2025-10-13&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=America/Toronto)

Summary of those 10 years:
- Mean about 13.6 C, median about 13.2 C, standard deviation about 2.5 C, range 10.3 to 18.3 C.
- About 7 of 10 years fell between 11 and 16 C.
- There is no clear warming trend: 2022-2024 were cool and 2016-2018 and 2021 were warm.
- Single days within the window swing a lot, from 7.0 C (2018-10-13) to 22.0 C (2018-10-10).

Seasonal drop:
- Normally the temperature falls about 6 to 8 C between mid-September (roughly 18 to 20 C) and mid-October (roughly 11 to 13 C), so the window comes during a fast cooling phase.
- 2026 so far: the Sept 1-14 average of about 20.4 C looks warm compared with typical early-September ERA5 values, though I did not pull exact September figures for earlier years.
- How warm early September was tells you little about one week in mid-October.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question or a closely related one.
- Expert outlooks:
  - The Weather Network expects near-seasonal temperatures through mid-October, leaning warm overall. [TWN](https://www.theweathernetwork.com/en/news/weather/seasonal/ontario-2026-fall-forecast)
  - Environment and Climate Change Canada's (ECCC) three-month outlook is reported as leaning above normal for Ontario. [TWN](https://www.theweathernetwork.com/en/news/weather/seasonal/ontario-2026-fall-forecast)
  - The Old Farmer's Almanac puts October near normal. [Narcity](https://www.narcity.com/fall-forecast-ontario-2026-chilly-temperatures-snow-showers)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late September and early October: the ECCC monthly and three-month outlooks and the NOAA CPC 8-14 day and week 3-4 outlooks will update. The 8-14 day outlook only reaches the Oct 7-13 window around Sept 23 to 29.
- The El Niño state is cited as the main seasonal driver (TWN). Skill at 3 to 4 weeks out is low.
- Latest official outlook covering the window: TWN says near seasonal to mild for mid-September to mid-October, and ECCC's three-month outlook leans above normal. I could not open the ECCC page directly, and some search results were dated after 2026-09-15, so I ignored them.
